name: dsh-chubby-whale
description: DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-version.mjs && node scripts/check-bom.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --format=iife --external:react --charset=utf8 --outfile=dist/client.js
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/check-imports.mjs && node scripts/gen-module-index.mjs --check && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-diag-keys.mjs && node scripts/check-text.mjs && node scripts/test.mjs && node scripts/test-chat-limits.mjs && node scripts/test-stream-ledger.mjs && node scripts/test-story-security.mjs && node scripts/test-behavior-regressions.mjs && node scripts/verify-voice.mjs && node scripts/smoke-client.mjs && node scripts/ape-bench.mjs && node scripts/smoke-host.mjs && node scripts/platform-check.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/gen-version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit

author: adengou
